item.title: Lower3 - Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview

  • Platform: Vulnyx
  • Difficulty: Low
  • OS: Linux
  • Attacker IP: 10.10.10.2
  • Target Machine IP: 10.10.10.6

The objective was to enumerate the target, discover an exposed NFS share, gain initial access by uploading a PHP reverse shell through the mounted web directory, and escalate privileges by abusing the no_root_squash NFS misconfiguration.

Port Scanning

RustScan

rustscan -a 10.10.10.6 -b 500 -- -sC -sV -A -oN nmap/init

Results

PORT      STATE SERVICE  REASON  VERSION
22/tcp    open  ssh      syn-ack OpenSSH 8.4p1 Debian 5+deb11u1
80/tcp    open  http     syn-ack Apache httpd 2.4.56 (Debian)
111/tcp   open  rpcbind  syn-ack 2-4 (RPC #100000)
2049/tcp  open  nfs      syn-ack 3-4 (RPC #100003)
36691/tcp open  mountd   syn-ack 1-3 (RPC #100005)
38605/tcp open  nlockmgr syn-ack 1-4 (RPC #100021)
42855/tcp open  mountd   syn-ack 1-3 (RPC #100005)
47283/tcp open  mountd   syn-ack 1-3 (RPC #100005)

Several services were exposed:

item.title: Lower5 - Walkthrough
item.description:

  • Platform: Vulnyx
  • Difficulty: Low
  • OS: Linux
  • Attacker IP: 10.10.10.2
  • Target Machine IP: 10.10.10.8

The objective was to enumerate the target, discover a Local File Inclusion (LFI) vulnerability, exploit Apache log poisoning to gain initial access, and escalate privileges through misconfigured sudo permissions and a password stored in the pass password manager.

80/tcp open  http    syn-ack Apache httpd 2.4.62 (Debian)

item.title: Lower2 - Walkthrough
